messages.content:
Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Preserve scope and constraints. Do not invent context, requirements, or missing information. Do not perform the task.", "input": "i need a short inspection record for these three climbing gear items, based only on the information below. list the items separately and keep observed condition, quoted remarks, and follow-up questions distinct. don't assign pass/fail or safe/unsafe status, since the notes don't give that result. keep each quoted remark exactly as written, and flag unclear or missing details instead of filling them in. helmet H-204: light surface scuff near the rear vent; chin strap buckle closes. remark from the check: "it caught once, then opened normally." harness HN-17: discoloration on the leg-loop webbing; no cut reported. the date on the tag is unreadable. note from the person there: "we used the backup harness after lunch." carabiner C-09: gate opened and closed twice during the check; no load test was done. remark: "the gate felt sticky at first." please make the record easy for another person to review, without turning the remarks into conclusions or assuming what caused any of the conditions. include any follow-up questions that arise from the notes, but don't answer them.", "output": "Prepare a short inspection record for the three climbing gear items listed below, using only the information provided. List each item separately, and distinguish observed condition, quoted remarks, and follow-up questions. Keep every quoted remark exactly as written. Flag unclear or missing details rather than filling them in. Do not assign pass/fail or safe/unsafe status, turn remarks into conclusions, or assume what caused any condition. Include follow-up questions raised by the notes, but do not answer them.

- Helmet H-204: light surface scuff near the rear vent; chin strap buckle closes. Remark from the check: "it caught once, then opened normally."
- Harness HN-17: discoloration on the leg-loop webbing; no cut reported. The date on the tag is unreadable. Note from the person there: "we used the backup harness after lunch."
- Carabiner C-09: gate opened and closed twice during the check; no load test was done. Remark: "the gate felt sticky at first.""}]
